propositions: ADR 0035 §6 must be amended to record that Jira Data Center (epic e369) landed as a second backend ahead of the GitHub adapter (be74), falsifying the 'out of scope' claim in three locations: diagram comment (:111), prose (:204-205), Decision item 6 (:236-237), and Consequences section

The TicketTransport protocol declares six members but the reconciler calls twenty-one distinct transport methods; twelve are absent from DC transport and undeclared on any Protocol, causing silent failures (7 swallowed by exception handlers, 3 mixed, 1 crash) while isinstance checks and contract suite pass
RemoteRef.instance is documented as deployment-distinguishing design but never constructed in production code (only in two test helpers), risking future reliance on an unpopulated field
The backend contract-suite certification claim in ADR 0035 is conditional on port completeness and type-annotation of transport parameters; unannotated parameters make port gaps invisible to mypy

A jira_family/ layer with parameterized RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel contracts now mediates between neutral core and concrete adapters, sharing one 'jira' creation channel and prefix with instance-based deployment distinction

The seam's operational gaps (index lag, pagination caps, rate limiting, screen config) manifest only on differently-configured instances, not architectural defects, paralleling mature third-party Jira integration patterns
